code: @Misc{nansiimbi_etall:2026,   title = {waterqualityuganda: Drinking Water Quality from Boreholes to Household Storage in Uganda},   author = {Cecilia Nansiimbi and Adriana {Clavijo Daza}},   year = {2026},   url = {https://github.com/openwashdata/waterqualityuganda},   abstract = {Monthly E. coli monitoring of drinking water along the chain from borehole sources to household storage in four Ugandan districts (Nakaseke, Kaabong, Kumi and Luuka) between November 2024 and September 2025. For each borehole, water was sampled at the source and, in three households using it, from the container used to carry water home and from the drinking water storage container. Samples were analysed by membrane filtration and classified into five contamination levels. The package provides four tidy datasets: field visits to boreholes, field visits to households, water samples with their laboratory results, and laboratory blanks.},   keywords = {water quality,E. coli,boreholes,household water storage,water transport,WASH,Uganda},   version = {0.0.0.9000}, }

code: library(waterqualityuganda) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  sample_type_labels <- c(   borehole = "Borehole",   transport_container = "Transport container",   storage_container = "Storage container" )  samples |>   filter(sample_type %in% names(sample_type_labels),          !is.na(contamination_category)) |>   count(sample_type, contamination_category) |>   mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type_labels[sample_type],                               levels = rev(sample_type_labels))) |>   ggplot(aes(x = n, y = sample_type, fill = contamination_category)) +   geom_col(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), colour = "white",            linewidth = 0.6, width = 0.7) +   scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(),                      expand = expansion(0)) +   scale_fill_manual(     values = c("#c6dbef", "#9ecae1", "#6baed6", "#3182bd", "#08519c")   ) +   guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +   labs(x = "Share of analysed samples", y = NULL,        fill = "Contamination category",        title = "E. coli contamination by sample type",        subtitle = "Four districts in Uganda, November 2024 to September 2025") +   theme_minimal() +   theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),         panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),         legend.position = "bottom",         legend.title.position = "top") samples |>   filter(sample_type == "storage_container",          !is.na(contamination_category)) |>   left_join(household_visits, by = "visit_id") |>   group_by(boils_water) |>   summarise(     n_samples = n(),     share_unsafe = mean(contamination_category == "Unsafe")   ) #> # A tibble: 2 × 3 #>   boils_water n_samples share_unsafe #>   <lgl>           <int>        <dbl> #> 1 FALSE             580        0.628 #> 2 TRUE              305        0.387

NA laboratory result linked field record (see match_status). region Region Uganda sample collected: Central Region, Karamoja Region, Teso Region Busoga Region. district District sample collected: Nakaseke, Kaabong, Kumi Luuka. laboratory form used spellings 'Kaboong' 'Kamuli' last two; harmonised field survey spelling. date_sampled Date sample collected (YYYY-MM-DD). laboratory results without field record incubation start date, study sampling date. sample_type sampled: 'borehole' (water borehole outlet), 'borehole_duplicate' (second bottle borehole taken quality assurance), 'transport_container' (water container used carry water borehole household), 'storage_container' (water household drinking water storage container). NA laboratory result field record. bottle_number Number written sample bottle field read laboratory. Numbering restarts every sampling day, identifies sample together district date_sampled. date_incubation Date sample filtered (membrane filtration) incubation started. NA laboratory result linked. date_result Date colonies counted laboratory form submitted, normally day date_incubation (18-24 h incubation). NA laboratory result linked. petri_dish_number Petri dish label used laboratory sample, recorded. entries placeholder values (e.g. 88888). NA laboratory result linked. ecoli_cfu Number E. coli colonies (colony forming units) counted membrane filter incubating volume_ml sample. laboratory instructed enter 101 100 colonies present (numerous count); values 101 recorded typed. NA laboratory result linked. tntc TRUE ecoli_cfu greater 100, meaning plate numerous count ecoli_cfu censored value rather exact count. NA laboratory result linked. volume_ml Volume sample water filtered, millilitres. 100 mL every analysed sample except one, '' selected without value (NA). NA laboratory result linked. contamination_category Contamination level derived ecoli_cfu thresholds used project: Safe (0), Slightly contaminated (1-10), Moderately contaminated (11-50), Highly contaminated (51-100), Unsafe (100). Ordered factor. NA laboratory result linked. lab_notes Free-text notes written laboratory technician sample (e.g. field blank, duplicate sample, visible maggots, interrupted incubation). match_status field record laboratory result linked district, date bottle number: 'matched' (exactly one field bottle one laboratory result share key), 'lab result' (field bottle without laboratory result), 'field record' (laboratory result without field record), 'ambiguous key' (key occurs field laboratory data, rows deliberately linked remain separate).
